posts.title: Why I built this website
posts.summary: A short note on what this site is for and how I plan to use it.
posts.body:
I am studying B.E. Computer Engineering in Nepal and learning to build real things with code.

This website is my public workspace. It holds my projects, my CV, a few free tools and, over time, notes on what I learn.

## What you will find here

- Projects, each marked as completed, in progress or planned
- Free browser tools that keep your data on your device
- Short posts about what I am learning

## What I am not claiming

I do not have professional experience yet. I am a student building skills in public, and I am looking for internships and small projects where I can learn from real work.
